headline: As of 2026-09-19: 7,363 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+47.8 registration lean.
bullets: 7,363 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+47.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (5,559), Pennsylvania (1,654), Florida (150).
